snippet.title: Ectorider - Anouncement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3970010/Ectorider/

Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ektos evil plan.

Website: https://www.ectorider.com/
Twitter: https://x.com/EctoriderGame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ectorider.com
